title: I made an Android survivor where you draw runes to cast spells
author: ZookeepergameOdd9524
selftext:
Hi everyone, I'm a Korean developer working on Rune Survivors, a pixel-art survivor for Android.

I wanted casting a spell to feel a little more hands-on. Your weapons attack while you move, but when a spell is ready, you draw its rune with your finger to cast it. This is a clip of me trying it on my phone. It's a Korean development build, so you'll see some debug buttons; the game also supports English.

I built it in Flutter/Dart with help from Codex for coding and debugging. English isn't my first language, so I also used it to help write this post. A lot of the work has been checking how things actually feel: crowded fights caused lag and delayed pickup sounds, and some upgrade icons didn't match the attacks. Those took several rounds of fixes and playtesting.

I'd love to hear whether the rune drawing looks like something you'd enjoy, and whether the combat is easy to read. If you try it, feedback on the first few minutes would help a lot.

It's free on Android, with ads:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runesurvivors.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runesurvivors.game)

comments.author: PlantLegacyGame
comments.body: Hey I won't be downloading your game because I don't like those types of game, but I want to give my opinion anyways: I think those types of 2d survivor games are meant to be fast paced and have hundreds of enemies rushing at you so wouldn't it be better to just select a spell type and then draw hand motion towards the enemy for a few enemies, or do the magic spell seal you already have for attack on everyone (AoE attacks) to make players feel more satisfied by having their efforts pay off, a longer spell casting time/ spell set up --> spell damage, area damage.

replies.author: ZookeepergameOdd9524
replies.body: Thanks, that makes sense. I want to keep the rune drawing, but you're right that the payoff needs to match the time spent casting. Making the full rune cast a bigger AoE spell sounds like a good direction. I'll keep that in mind as I work on the combat.
